name: Velton – Full Stack Developer Internship
description: Worked as a Full Stack Developer Intern at Velton AI, building production features with React and Flask and testing and mitigating web vulnerabilities, with a focus on secure application flows.

name: PKT-CORE – Cisco Packet Tracer File Generation SDK
description: Developed a Python SDK for programmatically generating Cisco Packet Tracer .pkt/.pka network simulation files, including topology construction, device configuration, IP addressing, links, and ACLs. Published as pkt-core on PyPI.

name: Image2Depth
description: Built a Pix2Pix-based image-to-image translation system in PyTorch to estimate monocular depth maps from dashboard images. Implemented U-Net and PatchGAN, improving MAE by 23.8% over baseline CNN regressors, with Ray Tune, W&B and MLflow.

name: DeepFaceEdit
description: Built a desktop application for facial synthesis and semantic editing with StyleGAN2-ADA and PyTorch, W+ latent-space editing, dlib alignment and image projection; achieved 18% lower L2 reconstruction error than baseline approaches.

name: Advanced Lane Detection
description: Developed a real-time OpenCV lane detection pipeline using calibration, distortion correction, perspective transformation, thresholding and sliding-window polynomial fitting, reporting 94.2% pixel-level accuracy.

name: Fathom AI
description: Built an AI meeting workspace with searchable meetings, transcripts, AI summaries, action items and decisions, user-scoped APIs, PostgreSQL persistence, Zod validation and read-only sharing.

name: Playwright QA Automation
description: Built TypeScript Playwright UI/API automation using Page Object Model for login, smoke tests, negative cases and API contracts, with retries, stable locators, expect.poll and diagnostic traces, videos and reports.

name: Playwright SQA Demo
description: Built a Playwright login testing framework with reusable Page Object Model classes, shared test steps and CSV-driven test scenarios.

name: Firebase Broken Access Control – Private Chat Exposure
description: Discovered misconfigured Firebase Firestore rules in a ride-sharing app allowing authenticated users to read and modify other users’ private chat messages; validated with controlled accounts and documented participant- and owner-based rules.

name: Broken Authentication – OTP Verification Bypass
description: Identified a signup flow that issued fully privileged JWTs before email OTP verification, permitting unverified accounts to access protected functionality; proposed post-verification token issuance and server-side enforcement.

name: Authorization Hack – FAST Connect
description: Identified and responsibly demonstrated an authorization vulnerability in FAST Connect that permitted unauthorized access to restricted resources; documented impact and access-control remediation.

name: PortSwigger Labs – XSS, CSRF, IDOR, and Authentication
description: Completed PortSwigger labs across XSS, CSRF, IDOR and authentication, practicing vulnerability discovery, request manipulation and mitigations.

name: ChefGPT
description: Built a React AI recipe assistant powered by Mixtral that generates recipe suggestions from ingredients, demonstrating API integration, responsive frontend design and state management.

name: Dark Mode – Google Classroom Extension
description: Built a browser extension that adds a dark theme to Google Classroom using CSS overrides, DOM manipulation and browser extension APIs.

name: North Peak Studios
description: Built and deployed a responsive creative studio website with Next.js, Tailwind CSS, Lenis smooth scrolling, Framer Motion/GSAP transitions, hover-driven project previews, mobile navigation, accessibility and analytics.

name: 3D Room Modeling
description: Built a browser-based 3D room editor with 18 furniture and structure pieces, click-to-place, grid-snapped dragging, orbit camera, recoloring, Zustand state, local saves, PNG snapshots and WebM recording.

name: Smart Task Management API
description: Built a multi-tenant .NET 8 task API using Clean Architecture, PostgreSQL, Auth0 tenant isolation, CQRS/MediatR, EF Core, Hangfire reminders, versioned endpoints, rate limiting and containerized integration tests.

name: Bookmarks Manager API
description: Built a .NET 10 ASP.NET Core Minimal API for bookmarks, nested folders and tags, with EF Core, SQLite/MariaDB, public reads, API-key-protected writes, Swagger, Docker and xUnit integration tests.

name: Track-yoself
description: Developed a self-hosted Python personal activity tracking application with structured persistence, historical activity workflows, modular tracking metrics and a focus on local data ownership.

name: LanDrop
description: Built a self-hosted LAN file sharing service with Python and FastAPI for uploading, downloading and streaming files between devices over HTTP, using efficient file I/O without third-party cloud storage.

name: Webhook Relay API
description: Built a FastAPI webhook ingestion and relay service with PostgreSQL and Redis, webhook verification, idempotency, asynchronous delivery, retries, persistent event state, destination validation and SSRF protection.
